title: Fin Chaser Sportfishing Charters

services.name: Book A Charter
services.desc: From the voracious and ever-eager black sea bass to “the bulldog at the bottom” (the tautog), and from the crazy-toothed triggerfish to the goofy-eyed flounder, these wrecks and reefs are swarming with fish. Knowing precisely where these wrecks are located (a closely guarded secret) and how to position the boat to fish them comes only with years of experience. Captain Dan of the Fin Chaser has been running boats off of Ocean City, Maryland for more than 35 years. While some slower boats are forced to stay closer to the inlet, the Fin Chaser’s speed allows our anglers to fish on wrecks that are much farther from the inlet and don’t get near the fishing pressure. blurb: Fin Chaser Sportfishing Charters has been filling coolers for over 30 years. We strive to offer customers an outstanding experience while keeping the cost as affordable as possible. Offering deep sea fishing trips from offshore canyon trips for big game to nearshore bottom fishing trips and everything in between. Fin Chaser is rigged for any type of action we might encounter with over 35 rod/reel combos onboard.
